title: Multiply two matrices
summary: A struct that owns a dynamically allocated block of numbers, functions that create and free it, and the triple loop.
hints: `struct matrix { int rows, cols; long *data; };` with the element `(i, j)` at `data[i * cols + j]`. Write `create(rows, cols)` (with `calloc`), `release(m)` and `multiply(a, b)`.
`c(i, j) = sum over k of a(i, k) * b(k, j)`. Check `a.cols == b.rows` before multiplying. Free everything you allocated.
